scope: All numbers authored. These are calculation/assumption probes, not learner results.

missing_endpoint.interpretation: Scenario bounds over this fixed set, not a confidence interval or imputation.

changing_mix.interpretation: Pooled success rises while each stratum worsens. Show the separate strata and their denominators; no weighted utility score or causal adjustment is introduced.

duplicated_rows.interpretation: Duplicated rows manufacture apparent precision. Even the 10-episode interval requires independent, comparable Bernoulli observations; ordinary adaptive learning history does not establish this.

matched_randomization.interpretation: Conditional calculation for randomized labels within independent matched family pairs, no interference, and a sharp no-effect null. Four favorable differences still give p=0.125. This is not evidence of no effect, an effect interval, a universal sample threshold, or an actual randomized study.

full_cost.interpretation: Cost ranking reverses. Efficiency superiority additionally requires comparable retained outcomes and acceptable trade-offs.

unplaced_cost.interpretation: Scenario endpoints require the extra time to be nonoverlapping. Five extra minutes ties B; more reverses the preference. Unplaced time has no known probability distribution; conclusion unresolved.

paired_change.interpretation: Five later successes are not five new capabilities. Neither the three changed outcomes nor the two maintained outcomes identify a causal learning effect.

repeated_peeking.model: 20 independent fair coin flips; two-sided exact binomial p <= .05
repeated_peeking.interpretation: Exact path counting under an invented null. Repeated fixed-sample tests raise the false-positive probability. This does not calibrate the actual learner data or choose a sequential method.
